description: RFC 5280 §6.1.5(g)(iii)(3) requires deduplication against all leaf-depth nodes, but the code deduplicates only against vpns_policies (nodes descended from anyPolicy). A policy present at leaf depth via a non-anyPolicy parent gets a duplicate node added. Practical impact: double-counting in policy tree output (does not affect accept/reject for explicit_policy==0 but breaks policy-tree inspection). File: pkix-path/src/lib.rs lines 2623-2641.
title: path: §6.1.5(g)(iii)(3) policy tree dedup uses wrong set
